text:
Be wise, my Sorrow, and remain calm.

You were demanding Night; it descends now, here it is:

A dark atmosphere wraps the city,

Bringing peace to some and unease to most.


While the great mass of vile mortals,

Under Pleasure's whip, that impassive executioner,

Harvests disappointments at the servile feast,

Offer me your hand, my Sorrow, come here,


Far from them. Look at the years gone by swaying,

In ridiculous garments, upon the balustrades

Of heaven; mocking nostalgia already rises from the waters;


The dying sun rests beneath an arch,

And, like an enormous belated shroud, toward the East,

Listen, dear one, listen how Night advances.

translation.title: Recollection
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the intimate address to Sorrow and the theatrical arrival of Night over the city.
